programs.sub_title: A Family Legacy: From Motel to Orchard House
programs.desc: Cappie and Alex revive a structure that's deeply personal to both Cappie and his father; moving it to a new spot, they transform it into a nostalgic orchard hideaway with rocking chairs, heirloom trees and heartwarming history built into every wall.

programs.title: Capturing Home
programs.desc: A newly divorced grandma moves across the country to be closer to her daughter and grandchild; this is her first house of her very own, and she needs Amy and Kate to help her design a French-inspired home to set the stage for her next chapter.

programs.title: Capturing Home
programs.desc: A couple needs help balancing quirky art vibes with a calmer style: their entryway, living room and dining room are a hodgepodge of mismatched oddities; Amy and Kate design an 80s deco interior that strikes the perfect balance.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: An adventurous couple builds a home with self-sustaining features near the Ozark National Forest; they both have renovation experience, but building on the dangerous mountainside terrain in a location plagued by flash floods will be a challenge.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: A father-son duo builds a 720-square foot stick-frame home completely off the grid in Mont.'s Flathead Valley.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: A family attempts to build a 400-square-foot cabin situated on a small island in Northern Idaho; access to the property is limited, and rough waters make it difficult to bring materials in; it's a race to the finish as winter hits the island early.
